title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain United States Naval Academy
description: Ten under-21-safe Annapolis food destinations with directly verified late hours. Confirm availability before leaving, especially on holidays.

cards.title: Naz's Halal Food
cards.subtitle: 2510 Riva Road, Suite A101, Annapolis
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to check the day’s schedule, then choose pickup or delivery from this Annapolis halal-food location.
cards.short_summary: A late-running halal-food option on Riva Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Naz's lists Annapolis hours through 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and through 4 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 10:30 AM–2 AM Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 AM–4 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Boli's
cards.subtitle: 1900 Forest Drive, Annapolis
cards.notes: Check the location’s ordering page before heading out; it identifies this Forest Drive shop and its late pickup and delivery hours.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery stop with weekend hours to 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Boli's lists the Annapolis location open until 1 AM Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 10 AM–1 AM Monday–Thursday and Sunday; 10 AM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Domino's on Bay Ridge Road
cards.subtitle: 914 Bay Ridge Road, Annapolis
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the official location page and recheck the posted close time before departing.
cards.short_summary: A Bay Ridge Road pizza option listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Annapolis page for 914 Bay Ridge Road lists the store open until 12 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 914 Bay Ridge Road
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently displays an open-until time of 12 AM; verify the day-specific status when ordering.

cards.title: Domino's at Forest Plaza
cards.subtitle: 77 Forest Plaza, Annapolis
cards.notes: Use the official store page for carryout or delivery and confirm the listed hours before making the Forest Plaza run.
cards.short_summary: A second Annapolis Domino's location listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Annapolis page for 77 Forest Plaza lists the store open until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently displays an open-until time of 12 AM; verify the day-specific status when ordering.

cards.title: McDonald's on West Street
cards.subtitle: 1941 West Street, Annapolis
cards.notes: For a drive-thru stop, use the official location page or mobile ordering; lobby and drive-thru hours are listed separately.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists this Annapolis drive-thru as open 24 hours daily; its lobby is listed until 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru open 24 hours daily; restaurant/lobby 6 AM–11 PM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Street
cards.subtitle: 1803 West Street, Annapolis
cards.notes: Order ahead or use the drive-thru, and consult the official location page for the current day’s late-night operating window.
cards.short_summary: A West Street taco stop with posted 1–2 AM closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's Annapolis location lists hours until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and until 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location listing: 9 AM–1 AM Sunday–Thursday; 9 AM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy's on West Street
cards.subtitle: 1949 West Street, Annapolis
cards.notes: Check the official location listing immediately before leaving, then use the posted restaurant service options for your order.
cards.short_summary: A West Street fast-food location listed to close at 3:59 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Annapolis directory lists the 1949 West Street location open until 3:59 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official Annapolis directory currently lists this location with a 3:59 AM closing time; verify hours before travel.

cards.title: El Toro Bravo Mexican
cards.subtitle: Annapolis, Maryland
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official site for the operating day, then plan an early late-night pickup when Friday hours extend later.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant with Friday service posted to 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: El Toro Bravo's official site lists Friday hours from 11 AM to 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday hours of 11 AM–2 AM; check the site for current hours on other days.

cards.title: Broadneck Grill & Cantina
cards.subtitle: 1364 Cape Saint Claire Road, Annapolis
cards.notes: Use the official directions and hours page to confirm service, particularly if relying on its separately listed late-night menu.
cards.short_summary: A Cape Saint Claire Road restaurant with a late-night menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Broadneck Grill & Cantina lists hours until 2 AM daily and states that a late-night menu is available until closing.
cards.source_title: Broadneck Grill & Cantina directions and hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 2 AM closing daily; it specifies a late-night menu until close after the main kitchen closes.

cards.entity_name: Ports of Call at DoubleTree Annapolis
cards.title: Ports of Call
cards.subtitle: 210 Holiday Court, Annapolis
cards.notes: Check the hotel’s dining page before leaving and use the Friday or Saturday dinner window when the restaurant is posted latest.
cards.short_summary: A hotel restaurant with Friday and Saturday hours to 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: DoubleTree Annapolis lists Ports of Call open until 2 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Ports of Call at DoubleTree Annapolis
cards.access_notes: Official hotel dining page lists weekday hours to 12 AM and Friday–Saturday hours from 5 PM–2 AM.
